_note: Per-playbook heuristic entrypoint/sink patterns for the WEB3 smart-contract audit playbooks (evm-external-flow, cosmos-abci-halt, anchor-solana). Kept as DATA (not Python) for the same reason as ai_audit_rules.json: codescan/*.py is itself source-scanned for dangerous literals, and a detector that hard-codes Solidity/Go/Rust sink tokens (delegatecall, selfdestruct, panic(, invoke_signed) would trip its own static-only lock. These drive ONLY the no-LLM heuristic analyst (graceful-degradation + the offline demo/screenshot); the LLM agents do the real KB-grounded audit. Sinks are co-designed with the fixture contract set under sample_web3/ so the deterministic analyst returns concrete, attacker-path-backed findings with no LLM and no operator input. Placeholders: {ep} = enclosing entrypoint name, {loc} = file:line of the sink.

sinks.title: Reentrancy via external value call before state update
sinks.attacker_path: The external entrypoint {ep} sends value with a low-level value-bearing call at {loc} while the caller's balance/accounting is still un-zeroed (checks-effects-interactions violated). A malicious contract re-enters {ep} from its receive()/fallback() and drains the pool before the first frame writes state.
sinks.impact: Loss of funds — the contract's entire withdrawable balance is drained in one transaction.

sinks.title: Privileged operation missing an access-control modifier
sinks.attacker_path: The state-changing function {ep} is declared external/public at {loc} with no owner/role modifier and no msg.sender check. Any address calls it directly to seize a privileged capability (mint, ownership transfer, or upgrade).
sinks.impact: Unauthorized mint / ownership takeover / arbitrary upgrade — full protocol compromise.

sinks.title: Oracle price consumed without a staleness / round check
sinks.attacker_path: The flow through {ep} reads a Chainlink feed at {loc} and uses the returned price without checking updatedAt/answeredInRound. On a stale or frozen feed the attacker transacts against an outdated price to buy/borrow at a mispriced rate.
sinks.impact: Mispriced trades / under-collateralized borrows draining the protocol.

sinks.title: Spot price from reserves — flash-loan manipulatable
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} derives a price from AMM spot reserves (getReserves/slot0) at {loc}. An attacker takes a flash loan, skews the reserves in the same transaction, executes against the manipulated price, then repays — no capital at risk.
sinks.impact: Loss of funds via flash-loan price manipulation of a single-block spot oracle.

sinks.title: Arithmetic in an unchecked block
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} performs arithmetic inside an `unchecked` block at {loc}, disabling Solidity 0.8 overflow protection. Attacker-sized input wraps a balance or supply counter around zero.
sinks.impact: Balance/accounting corruption — inflated balances or bypassed supply caps.

sinks.title: delegatecall / selfdestruct reachable from an entrypoint
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} reaches a delegatecall/selfdestruct at {loc}. If the target or calldata is attacker-influenced, the attacker runs arbitrary code in this contract's storage context (or destroys it), overwriting owner/implementation slots.
sinks.impact: Arbitrary storage write / contract destruction — total loss of control and funds.

sinks.title: Authorization via tx.origin
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} authorizes using tx.origin at {loc}. A malicious contract the victim is tricked into calling forwards the call so tx.origin is still the victim — the check passes for the attacker.

sinks.title: Explicit panic reachable in a production ABCI path
sinks.attacker_path: The ABCI method {ep} calls panic() at {loc} on a condition an attacker controls (a crafted message field / proposal). Because BeginBlock/EndBlock/DeliverTx run inside consensus, the panic aborts block processing on every validator — a chain halt, not a caught error.
sinks.impact: Full consensus halt — the chain stops producing blocks until a coordinated patched restart.
sinks.poc: go test ./... -run TestABCIPanicHalt -v   # submit the crafted message against a local node

sinks.title: sdk.Int/Dec arithmetic that panics on underflow or divide-by-zero
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} performs sdk math (.Sub/.Quo/.Mul) at {loc} on an attacker-influenced amount. cosmos-sdk Int.Sub panics on a negative result and Quo panics on divide-by-zero; a message that drives the operand negative/zero halts the block.
sinks.impact: Consensus halt via an arithmetic panic inside a consensus-critical handler.

sinks.title: Must*/mustGet helper that panics inside consensus
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} calls a Must*/mustGet helper at {loc} that panics instead of returning an error. When the looked-up key is absent or the input fails to (un)marshal for attacker-chosen data, the panic propagates out of the ABCI method and halts the chain.
sinks.impact: Consensus halt from an unhandled Must* panic on attacker-shaped state.

sinks.title: Slice index / type assertion without bounds or ok check
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} indexes a slice/map by an attacker-supplied position, or type-asserts without the comma-ok form, at {loc}. An out-of-range index or wrong dynamic type panics; inside DeliverTx/EndBlock that panic halts consensus.
sinks.impact: Consensus halt via index-out-of-range / nil-pointer / failed type assertion.

sinks.title: UncheckedAccount / AccountInfo consumed without owner or constraint
sinks.attacker_path: The account in {ep}'s context is typed UncheckedAccount/AccountInfo at {loc} with no #[account(owner = ...)] / has_one / typed Account<T> wrapper. Anchor skips owner + discriminator validation, so an attacker passes an account they control where a program-owned account is expected.
sinks.impact: Account-substitution — attacker-owned state is treated as trusted, enabling fund theft or authority spoof.

sinks.title: Authority account not constrained to a Signer
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} treats an `authority`/`owner` account as trusted at {loc} but types it as AccountInfo/UncheckedAccount instead of Signer<'info> and never asserts is_signer. An attacker supplies the real authority's pubkey without its signature and passes the check.
sinks.impact: Signer spoofing — privileged instructions execute on behalf of an authority who never signed.

sinks.title: Unchecked lamport/token arithmetic
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} does raw +/-/* on a balance/amount at {loc} without checked_add/checked_sub. In release builds Rust arithmetic wraps silently, so an attacker-sized amount underflows a balance to a huge value.
sinks.impact: Balance underflow/overflow — inflated balances and drained vaults.

sinks.title: CPI (invoke/invoke_signed) to an unverified program
sinks.attacker_path: {ep} performs a cross-program invocation at {loc} without asserting the target program id (e.g. token_program.key == token::ID). An attacker passes a look-alike program that mimics the interface but steals or mis-credits the transferred tokens.
sinks.impact: Arbitrary-program CPI — token theft / privilege confusion via a spoofed program account.
